faqPage.title: Answers to the most common questions
faqPage.subtitle: Can't find your question here? Reach out directly and we'll answer you.

items.q: What documents are required to open a pharmacy or clinic?
items.a: Requirements vary by facility type and governorate. We provide a complete, up-to-date checklist when you start working with us, and follow up on each document with you step by step.

items.q: How long does the licensing process take?
items.a: Timelines vary depending on facility type and the relevant regulatory body. We give you a realistic estimate after reviewing your specific case.

items.q: Can you provide the land for the facility?
items.a: Yes, we help source suitable land based on your location and facility type; you then handle the construction itself.

items.q: Do you serve clients outside Egypt?
items.a: Yes, we work with clients across multiple Arab countries and can manage the process even if you're not based in Egypt full-time.

items.q: Which medical specialties do you consult on?
items.a: We cover all major medical specialties, in addition to veterinary consulting.

items.q: Is the legal service standalone, or does it require other services?
items.a: Legal consulting and licensing is available independently — it doesn't need to be bundled with another service.

items.q: How do I start the conversation with you?
items.a: Via WhatsApp or the contact form on the site, and our team will respond as soon as possible.

items.q: Do you help relocate staff between facilities?
items.a: Yes, we facilitate the transfer process by coordinating with both facilities and the relevant authorities.
